name: huzaifa-marketplace
description: Huzaifa Usman's LinkedIn studio: a Claude Code plugin that renders dark blue image stills and short videos scored with local music, in the two LinkedIn feed shapes (square, portrait). Everything renders on the machine.

plugins.name: huzaifa-studio
plugins.description: Render a LinkedIn image still (insight/list/stat/quote/showcase) or a short video with music: dark blue on near-black, a dim mesh background, Inter. Square 1080x1080 or portrait 1080x1350 from the same brief. Stills at 4x, video at 2x, all local via Remotion.
